front: What is Cookie errors (cross-origin dev & prod) in one sentence?
back: Browser blocked the cookie — almost always SameSite/Secure/domain mismatch, missing CORS credentials, or third-party cookie phaseout — not "cookies broken."

front: Explain the mental model of Cookie errors (cross-origin dev & prod) (how the system thinks).
back: Cookies are set by Set-Cookie on a response and sent on matching requests per domain/path/SameSite/Secure rules. Cross-origin SPA (frontend localhost:3000, API localhost:4000) is not same-site; production subdomain splits (app.example.com vs api.example.com) are same-site but still cross-origin for CORS.

back: Backend (Express example):

front: Symptom: Login OK, next request 401 — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Cookie not stored (Secure on HTTP) · Fix: HTTPS or disable Secure locally

front: Symptom: Works in Chrome, not Safari — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: ITP; third-party cookie blocked · Fix: First-party cookie on shared parent domain

front: Symptom: POST login loses cookie — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: SameSite=Lax blocks cross-site POST · Fix: SameSite=None + Secure or same-origin proxy

front: Symptom: Cookie set but not on API calls — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Wrong Domain (host-only vs .parent) · Fix: Set Domain=.example.com

front: Symptom: CORS error + no cookie — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Allow-Origin: * with credentials · Fix: Explicit origin whitelist

front: Symptom: After OAuth redirect, session gone — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: SameSite strict on redirect chain · Fix: Lax or None on OAuth callback path

front: Symptom: document.cookie can't read — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: HttpOnly (correct for session) · Fix: Use API /me, not JS read

front: Gotcha with Cookie errors (cross-origin dev & prod): what silently fails?
back: Frontend and backend on two different registrable domains — SameSite=None; Secure + third-party cookie deprecation in Chrome may still block; prefer same-site proxy (nginx /api → backend).

front: When should you NOT use Cookie errors (cross-origin dev & prod)?
back: Cookie for API tokens in mobile native apps — use Authorization header + secure storage. Large payloads in cookies — 4KB limit; use session server-side id only.
